=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh:139-142 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The dedupe filter `(.body | sub("\\s+\\z"; "") | endswith($marker))` accepts any trusted comment whose body ends with the marker, including one that only quotes the marker as its last text (e.g. `Quoted: <!-- rb-judge-crash:v1 head=<sha> reason=<reason> -->`), not just a standalone marker line.
  WHY: On a later judge crash with the same head and reason, the script sets `RB_JUDGE_CRASH_REPEAT=true`, skips the blocked-comment POST and suppresses the CRITICAL Telegram alert. Severity disagreement: openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR (confidence 4). minimax_minimax-m3 rated it NIT (confidence 3) because the linked issue's Risks section accepts marker spoofing ("A spoof can at most suppress an alert. ACCEPTED.") and this is narrower than the old `contains` rule. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point only as advisory hardening, not as a defect.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- HARDENING_SUGGESTION (advisory, not a defect): scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh line 142, the jq dedupe filter
  PROBLEM: endswith($marker) also matches a trusted comment whose last text is the marker inline after other text, e.g. "Quoted: <!-- rb-judge-crash:v1 head=... reason=... -->". The step itself always writes the marker after a blank line ("\n\n" at line 128).
  WHY: Not reported as a defect because only comments by the token's own identity count, editor summaries never end with this marker, and no other code path writes it. Suggested fix: change to endswith("\n" + $marker), or test("(^|\\n)" + ...) with the marker escaped, and add a "Quoted: <marker>" test case (about 1 line in the script, about 6 in the test). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh:jq filter at the dedupe count (post-`sub` line) and the new endswith-based comment block, lines ~139-142 in the LAST RUN DIFF | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new endswith rule still matches a trusted comment whose body ends with the exact marker text after trailing whitespace is stripped (e.g. an AI editor summary ending "...see marker `<!-- rb-judge-crash:v1 head=<sha> reason=<reason> -->`"). The code comment's claim that "a trusted comment that merely quotes the marker cannot suppress the alert" is imprecise.
  WHY: On a later crash with the same head and reason, `endswith($marker)` matches, `RB_JUDGE_CRASH_REPEAT=true` is written, the POST is skipped and the CRITICAL Telegram page is suppressed. The reviewer notes this is within the issue's accepted spoof risk, is narrower than the old `contains` rule and is not a regression.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: jq filter in the dedupe count line (~line 142)
  PROBLEM: The rule still accepts `prose <!-- rb-judge-crash:v1 head=H reason=R -->`.
  WHY: Suggested fix: replace `(.body | sub("\\s+\\z"; "") | endswith($marker))` with `(.body | test("\\n[ \\t]*" + $marker_escaped + "\\s*\\z"))`, pre-escaping `$marker` and keeping fail-open behaviour (3-5 lines). This changes the dedupe contract and needs owner approval rather than an autofix. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

  WHY: A trusted comment ending with `Quoted: <!-- rb-judge-crash:v1 head=<sha> reason=<reason> -->` matches `endswith($marker)`. On a later crash with that head and reason, the script sets `RB_JUDGE_CRASH_REPEAT=true`, and the workflow skips the blocked-comment POST and suppresses the CRITICAL Telegram alert.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===

- HARDENING_SUGGESTION (advisory, not a defect): scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh line 142, the dedupe jq filter (`endswith($marker)`)
  PROBLEM: A trusted comment whose body merely ends with the marker (e.g. a bot-authored editor summary that quotes it as the final text) still counts as a repeat and suppresses the first CRITICAL judge-crash alert for that head and reason. The filter does not require the marker to start its own line, but the step always writes it after `$'\n\n'` (line 128).
  WHY: Within the issue's accepted risk ("A spoof can at most suppress an alert. ACCEPTED."). Suggested fix: `endswith("\n" + $marker)`, adjust the trailing-whitespace strip, and add a test case (about 2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
